# Farteks

Farteks is a Türkiye-based manufacturer and exporter of hydraulic cylinder components for OEM and industrial applications.

## Core product groups
- Standard 1 Components
- Standard 2 Components
- Mobile Crane Components
- Rod End Components
- ISO Cylinder Components
- Trunnion Components
- Custom Hydraulic Components
- Hydraulic Power Unit Components

## Product information
Product pages contain the available dimensions, codes, technical specification tables and technical drawings. Catalog-derived data should be treated as the source of truth for listed product variants.
